reviews.text:
We had an absolutely incredible experience at Magos celebrating my birthday, and I cannot recommend this restaurant enough. We rented out the entire space, and from start to finish everything exceeded expectations.
The food was outstanding—beautifully prepared, full of flavor, and consistently excellent across every course. The atmosphere was warm, vibrant, and perfect for a celebration, creating an unforgettable setting for our guests.
What truly made the night exceptional, however, was the staff. Maria Elena and Lorenzo were beyond incredible—attentive, professional, warm, and genuinely invested in making sure every detail was perfect. Their service elevated the entire evening. A huge thank you as well to Sergio, the General Manager, whose leadership and coordination were evident throughout the night. Everything ran seamlessly.
If you are looking for a place that delivers amazing food, a fantastic ambiance, and truly exceptional service—especially for a special event—Magos is it. This was a birthday celebration I will never forget.

Hi Kira! Thank you for celebrating your birthday with us! We’re so glad everything exceeded expectations and will be sure to share your kind words with Maria Elena, Lorenzo, and Sergio. We can’t wait to welcome you back again 💜 …

We had an incredible experience at Mago Grill for our first visit, and a big part of that was thanks to our amazing waiter, Roberto. He went above and beyond to make our night special. The ambience was beautiful, the food was absolutely delicious, the margaritas were delicious, and the service was outstanding. We’re already planning to come back—and we definitely hope to be seated with Roberto again. Highly recommend!

We’re glad you enjoyed the moles, the margaritas, the atmosphere, and everything in between. We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon — and we’ll definitely do our best to seat you with Roberto!
— The MAGO Grill Team

reviews.text:
Really good food. Great margaritas here and the three salsas you get with the chips are so tasty, especially the hot orange one..
It's not a traditional tacos, rice and beans Mexican restaurant, not that they don't have those things. Tasty sauces and sides. I'm not sure that Mexican style mashed potatoes or asparagus are authentic, but they sure are delicious! The availability of the asparagus was great for someone trying to keep it at least somewhat lower carb. My husband's fish dish had a side of chayote, which he never had before... But loved. So I guess I have to figure out how to cook that now. Anyways, great food. Cool decor on the inside, husband loved the wrestling masks.

My wife and I love Mago. This was our first time at this location but it was as good as the other Mago locations we've been too. While Mago is a chain of restaurants, it holds to a higher standard of service and food quality and that's what makes it good.
On our most recent visit, we attended a Day of the Dead inspired Tequila Pairing Dinner where 818 Tequila cocktails were created and paired with unique Mago dishes. These types of dinners allow the chefs to be creative and gives us, their patrons, the opportunity to try truly unique dinners that may never appear on the menu.
